what: DAILY-DD-SWITCH never folds equity unless an order is evaluated. MEASURED 2026-10-09 19:40Z: all 13 armed accounts read_state=not_observed with day_start_equity null, and log_file name=daily_dd_switch_state present:false, 1h35m after the 18:05Z deploy. Cause (read in code): DailyDDSwitch.observe() is called only from RiskManager.check_dd_switch(), called only from RiskManager.evaluate() (risk.py:932), reached only when a signal produces an order package; the newest order_packages row was 13:33Z (journal?table=order_packages, 15 newest), i.e. no evaluation since arming. Consequences: (1) the criterion 'read_state ok on armed accounts' is unreachable on quiet accounts (prop accounts trade rarely); (2) day_start_equity becomes the equity at the FIRST evaluation after reset, not the day-start equity, so a loss accrued before the first signal of the day is invisible to the 3% limit; (3) trip/reset alerts wait for a signal. Proposed Tier-3 change (risk code; operator to approve before merge): call risk_manager.check_dd_switch() once per tick for every armed account (coordinator tick, after note_live_equity where a live total is known, else the <=2h balance snapshot), observe-only, never refusing there; test: a tick with no signal writes runtime_logs/daily_dd_switch_state.json. Subsumes the per-tick-observe clause of PI-20261009-BKKVRSVQ-0002. Basis: population = the 13 non-retired accounts listed by /api/bot/config accounts[].daily_dd_switch at 2026-10-09T19:40Z (breakout_1 retired, null excluded); the 3% is the configured non-prop limit, not a measurement.
